# @aponiajs/cqrs

> Nest-compatible CQRS module for AponiaJS (`CommandBus`, `QueryBus`, `EventBus`, `@Saga()`, `AggregateRoot`) using Promises and `AsyncIterable` streams without RxJS.

## Key exports

- `CqrsModule` (`forRoot()`)
- `CommandBus` / `@CommandHandler(Command)` / `ICommandHandler`
- `QueryBus` / `@QueryHandler(Query)` / `IQueryHandler`
- `EventBus` / `@EventsHandler(...Events)` / `IEventHandler`
- `@Saga()` / `ISaga`
- `AggregateRoot` / `EventPublisher`
